manifestSplitThisRelease.note: Per this release's instructions, artifact manifest is split into fetch_manifest.jsonl (request-level, 1 row per HTTP request WHERE RAW BYTES WERE PERSISTED) and posting_manifest.parquet/csv (record-level, 1 row per distinct posting WITH SOME CAPTURED DATA). Neither covers the full discovered corpus -- see known_gaps in HANDOFF.json.

scaleDisclosure.note: The gap between 40,551 discovered IDs and 137 detail-captured postings is the single largest scale gap in this release -- full-corpus detail collection (required for CRAWL_RELEASE_READY per the E2E Definition of Done) was not attempted this pass; it would require an estimated 10+ hours of continuous 1req/sec collection even for just the 21 already-discovered months, and the full 79-month corpus is expected to be several times larger still.
